terry mclaurin.note: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.
terry mclaurin.name: Terry McLaurin

javon kinlaw.note: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.
javon kinlaw.name: Javon Kinlaw

javontae jean-baptiste.note: The Commanders placed Jean-Baptiste (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday.
javontae jean-baptiste.name: Javontae Jean-Baptiste
